notes.title: Free Retrobooster Demo available on Steam
notes.notes:
Want some old school action? Try out this [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/392320/]free playable demo[/url] to get a taste of Retrobooster.

Retrobooster is all about the feel of flying and shooting, so you can use any game controller and customize its settings. I still prefer using a mouse for its speed and accuracy. Try it however you like. Or find a friend and blow each other up in some split-screen deathmatch.

Want splatterable alien monsters and lightning weapons? Sorry, those come later in the full version.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 update
notes.notes:
This update fixes specific problems playing on Windows: the time played was not being counted, and Retrobooster was launching in the background in Big Picture Mode. After updating, these behaviors should be fixed.

There are also some tiny improvements to game controller menu input and some sound fx. And a small bug was fixed that you probably never encountered because it was very rare.
